Name: BGM Separator
Author: GaugeMage
Punchline: Routes FFXIV's background music to its own audio device so streamers can keep BGM in VODs while excluding it from the live stream.
Description: Detects the currently playing FFXIV BGM, decodes the game's own music file, and plays it out through an audio device you choose (e.g. a virtual audio cable). Combined with muting the game's built-in BGM, this lets OBS capture the music on a separate source that you can include in recordings but leave off the stream track. See the README for OBS routing.
